semantic_reason: Issue #98 reports a FunctionClauseError crash in decode_message/1 after upgrading to 0.9.0 when a Pub/Sub message has payloadFormat NONE and no data key. The PR adds pattern-match clauses to handle nil data and the NONE payload case, and adds a regression test, changing existing behavior to fix a reported failure rather than introducing new functionality.
